in_marathi.name: Anupama
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Precious, Intimate, Beloved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anupama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu means 'drop' and pama means 'tide, wave'. The name Anupama can be translated as 'precious drop' or 'intimate wave'. This name is used to describe something that is precious and intimate, like a precious drop of water or an intimate wave of emotion.
